live_fallback_exercise.primary_failure: controlled HTTP 403, not an observed local primary failure
live_fallback_exercise.alias_response: actual network download through production acquire()

limitations: This is a hostname alias on the same university service, not an independent archival provider.
Local success does not establish availability from a GitHub-hosted runner.
Fallback is permitted only after transport failure, never checksum, format or size failure.
Original acquisition manifest and checksum remain unchanged.
PDF originals and probe downloads remain ignored; this receipt redistributes no paper.

new_cases: changed pin or original URL does not unlock alias
wrong alias bytes are never staged
